verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents its own dedicated test-account environment with a public signup, test cards, and per-scenario testing guides for payments, disputes, fraud detection, payouts, and AVS/ANI checks. A separate sandbox endpoint (sbox.cko.tech) also exists alongside production. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the test cards cover decline scenarios, documentation that the sandbox mirrors production behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and test the entire payment flow in a sandbox or test mode that mirrors production, with test cards for every scenario including declines and disputes

citations.quote: A dedicated test-account environment with per-scenario testing docs: payments testing, test cards, disputes testing, fraud-detection testing, bank payouts testing, AVS/ANI check testing
